endpoint.description: Action text is at most 280 UTF-16 units and rejects C0/DEL. Runtime requires validated raw DNS/IPv4/IPv6 host of at most 253 characters and integer port 1..65535. URLs, credentials, path/query/fragment, zone identifiers, trailing-dot DNS and original port 0/prefix-bypass cases are not accepted. Optional original family prefix is parsed but actual transport family is derived from the validated host.

A changed endpoint retires active or unconfirmed DeoVR ownership, invalidates pending work and stops output before storing inert preferences; failed/uncertain closure prevents replacement. Original shortcut can update Endpoint while connected without retargeting its already-open socket. Unchanged validated settings are an inert success. No automatic reconnect/Arm, Windows process check, WPF editor/Fody lifecycle or player-version equivalence is claimed.

path.description: Only active connected DeoVR is supported. Action text is at most 4096 UTF-16 units and rejects C0/DEL; wire validation further rejects whitespace-only or malformed Unicode paths. Original common string action forwards a potentially null/unbounded string to the selected source. Internal/native-video/other source path-change behavior remains absent.

Sent path is remote command metadata only and never an openable local URI or authorization. No optimistic resource/clock state is installed; actual received path revision triggers existing authorized Download/managed-library catalog search and guarded reads. Finite parser/search/read budgets, basename-based matching hint, missing original path-modifier/source-directory/resource-equality behaviors and Windows/WPF repository lifecycle remain partial.

Path change and every remote seek revoke physical Arm before sending. The retained protocol has no correlated seek ACK, server timestamp or command/resource-instance identifier. Local write completion and nearby received position never preserve or restore Arm; received current-resource evidence plus an explicit user re-Arm are required.
